body: ACK D1/D5/D6 assignment. I will audit against current source and ratified ADR 0007, not against the advisor API sketch: map the portable evidence, feature, proposal, provider and deterministic-resolution contracts; identify the smallest coherent new slice and exact existing types it must reuse; name collisions or authority leaks; and provide at least one court that rejects a plausible late-fusion implementation which misbinds time, modality, identity or derivation while looking structurally valid. Read-only: no module, dependency, public vocabulary or ADR change is implied.
